## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `pytest -q` pass
- [ ] Changes to the review gate, sandbox, address checks or agent allowlists have a security test
- [ ] No scraped data, credentials, proxy lists or personal data committed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
